description: Generate production-ready GitHub Actions workflows and custom actions with security-hardened defaults.

evals.name: Generate a basic Node.js CI workflow
evals.prompt: Create a GitHub Actions workflow for a Node.js project that runs on push and pull_request, installs dependencies, and runs tests.
evals.expected_output: A .github/workflows/*.yml file with SHA-pinned actions, explicit minimal permissions, a checkout + setup-node + npm ci + npm test sequence, and concurrency controls — following the skill's Mandatory Standards.

uncovered: create a composite action that combines these steps
make this workflow reusable so other repos can call it
add dependency review / SBOM scanning to our workflow
validate my existing workflow file (negative trigger)
